turn_history.text: I have: Which of these shows part of the proof that the sum of two odd numbers is even? I got \( \begin{array}{l}2 n+(2 m+1) \\ =2(n+m)+1\end{array} \) because I'm not sure I worked it out the right way.

turn_history.speaker: teacher
turn_history.text: Let's go back to the part you do know, and build the next step from there. Think about how you can use the fact that 2n represents an even number to help you in this proof. Remember, we are looking at the sum of two odd numbers.

score.justification_pass2: While the teacher attempts to scaffold by redirecting to known concepts, they repeat the exact same prompt verbatim in Turn 3 without adjusting support based on the student's specific confusion about representation and addition, failing to break down the problem into manageable steps or adapt to observed progress.
